llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed router and onboarding guide for an AI content/business skill family, with a read-only local discovery script that users should be aware of.

dimensions.detail: Local skill enumeration and path display are disclosed and useful for dynamic routing, though exposing real filesystem paths is more detail than the user usually needs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package includes a shell script that lists installed aikey-family skills by reading local skill directories and descriptions; no install hook, network fetch, dependency install, destructive command, or remote execution was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some activation phrases are broad, but the runtime instructions constrain the skill to routing, onboarding, and post-task navigation rather than executing unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The entry skill itself does not establish persistence; shared family guidance describes downstream draft and memory writes, but the router's main flow stops after prompt generation and the onboarding mode explicitly says it does not write files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to route users to the right aikey skill, run a short onboarding demo, and generate prompts rather than perform hidden work; the artifact content is coherent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an aikey-family router that can inspect locally installed aikey skills and guide you to the right one. Be aware that its discovery helper may reveal local skill directory paths in the conversation, and downstream aikey skills may read configured vault/material folders or write drafts and memory records according to their own instructions.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The local installed-skill enumeration is real and disclosed in the skill; it is purpose-aligned for dynamic routing, but users should know it can show real local skill paths.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger phrases may cause accidental activation, but the skill's resulting behavior is limited to onboarding or routing and does not itself take high-impact actions.
[SQP-1] expected: The new-user trigger phrases are broad, but they lead to a guided demo with numbered choices and no file writes, so the impact is limited.
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced local artifacts were available in the workspace and inspected; this did not substantiate analysis evasion.
[SDI-2] expected: The shell script is a read-only discovery helper that searches expected skill locations and prints names, descriptions, and paths; it does not modify files or contact the network.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Although several reference files are written in Chinese, the main skill explicitly instructs the agent to reply in the user's language, so a forced-locale concern was not substantiated.
[SDI-2] expected: Reading local rules or vault material is consistent with the broader aikey workflow and is disclosed, though users should keep private vault content scoped appropriately.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Chinese comments in the helper script do not impose a user-facing locale restriction.
